title: Variable Exponent Regularity via Muckenhoupt Condition
summary: For the first time, we establish higher integrability of the gradient and local $L^\infty$ estimates of weak solutions to the $p(x)$-Laplacian without assuming $\log$-Hölder continuity of $p$. Instead, we establish these results for exponents satisfying a generalized Muckenhoupt condition. This admits discontinuous exponents acting as pointwise multipliers of the BMO class. Our framework bridges the gap between classical $p(x)$-regularity and weighted Muckenhoupt theory, providing a new foundation for the analysis of differential equations with highly irregular non-standard growth.
